GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider permitted to ride 0.5kg overweight in accordance with the policy. Rider expressed concerns with the mare’s actions over the concluding stages of the event and was hesitant to fully test the mare. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to have cardiac arrhythmia. As this was the first occasion, Trainer was advised of the provisions under AR88(2)(b). Vet clearance since received.
Passing the 150m had to be redirected to the inside of runner after improving onto that runners’ heels, then became held up and was not able to be fully tested over the final 100m.
